[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Extend the workspace-exclusivity guarantee to the sase-github [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]plugin[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The sase-github plugin acquires workspaces the same way the rest of[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]SASE does: every gh__setup and GitHub-submit allocation is a single[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]atomic claim whose result is checked and whose ledger record names [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its caller, a pinned n=<num> target that a live agent holds fails [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with that agent named instead of being taken, and no gh workflow [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]step stashes, pulls, or checks out inside a checkout another live [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent occupies.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Atomic, checked workspace acquisition in the sase-github [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]plugin[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]gh_atomic[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gh_atomic: replace the check-then-claim allocation in gh__setup and in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the GitHub submit path with a single atomic claim, check every claim [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]result, make a pinned n=<num> target a single-shot claim that names the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]occupant on failure, release the slot when materialization fails, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]give every claim and release a caller tag.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse gh workflow steps that would prepare an occupied [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]checkout[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]gh_guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gh_atomic[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gh_guard: write the per-checkout occupant record when gh__setup takes a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace, clear it on release, and require the occupancy decision [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before gh__prepare stashes, gh__checkout checks out, or the GitHub [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]submit path checks out, so a conflicting occupant fails the run instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of losing another agent's work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
